caption: The drawing depicts a triangular textile fragment with a mostly dark blue central fabric adorned with various colorful embroidered patterns. The upper edge of the textile has a pale yellow-green border with a blue and white braided trimming. The central area of the textile features embroidered designs in shades of red, orange, green, pink, blue, brown, and purple, including abstract patterns and floral motifs. The embroidery appears dense and textured, with the stitching forming raised areas and shapes. Several threads and decorative details extend from the jagged lower and side edges of the textile, adding splashes of color such as red, green, blue, and yellow. The textile is placed against a plain, unadorned background, with a faint rectangular border sketched lightly around it on the cream-colored paper.
title: Quilt Section - Patchwork
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
